description: Keep the final reply in the user's conversational language, 2–4 short sentences (25–60 words): report the verified result and ask ONE relevant optional next-step question about ONE action, not a choice menu. Mandatory missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically; respect requests for no suggestions. Saved links let friends join without accounts. If CURRENT received UI context or actual host evidence confirms the same saved plan and last-action module are already open, do not call open_planner again; realtime updates the existing view. Historic context is insufficient. Otherwise open the last-action module with the selected credentials, or honor an explicit opening request. Up-vote ("up"), down-vote ("down") or remove your vote ("clear") on a place, by place_id from get_plan. Changes only the participant bound to the supplied credentials. Current stored state is available through get_plan. Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

place_id.description: From get_plan places[].place_id or add_place (the exact place name also works).

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.
